headline: US Stocks Rise as SpaceX and AI Sentiment Lift Nasdaq
summary: US stocks ended higher on Wednesday as SpaceX and Super Micro Computer boosted sentiment around artificial intelligence stocks, leading the Nasdaq higher.
why: Broad market indexes like the Nasdaq track the performance of major technology corporations. Sentiment in the tech sector heavily influences overall US equity market direction.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Positive corporate earnings and AI sentiment drove broad buying across major technology shares.

why_moved: Strong financial results and optimism surrounding artificial intelligence boosted investor risk appetite, lifting major indices.
